question: Which of the following languages does a computer use to process data?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Binary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A binary language:**

 
 
• **It is the one that represents texts, instructions for processors, or other data using the two-symbol system, generally, the two numbers used by the binary language in computers are 1 and 0.**
 
• It represents text, **PC processor directions, or other information utilizing any two-image framework,** yet frequently the double number framework's** 0 and 1.**
 
• **A bit string deciphered as a paired number can be converted into a decimal number.**
 
• It helps in preparing the data and also the guidelines while performing tasks in** PC processing.**
 
• **The 0s and 1s in binary represent OFF or ON, respectively.**
 
• In a transistor, **0** represents **no flow of electricity,** and **1** represents **electricity is allowed to flow.**
 
• In this way, numbers are represented physically inside the computing device, permitting calculations.
